candidates.label: Influenza A-associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis with meningoencephalitis
missing_or_uncertain: Viral PCR or serology for influenza A

candidates.label: Viral meningoencephalitis (influenza A) with reactive hemophagocytic syndrome
Tuberculous meningitis with secondary hemophagocytic syndrome
Systemic lupus erythematosus with CNS vasculitis and secondary hemophagocytic syndrome

contradiction_refs: F10 (bone marrow trilineage hematopoiesis, no malignant cells)
candidates.label: Primary CNS lymphoma with leptomeningeal involvement and hemophagocytosis

response.rationale: The combination of high fever, headache, lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly, hemophagocytosis in bone marrow, CSF pleocytosis with markedly elevated protein and normal glucose, and leptomeningeal enhancement, together with known influenza A exposure, strongly supports an infection-triggered hemophagocytic syndrome with CNS involvement. Normal CSF glucose and negative autoantibodies argue against TB and SLE, while the bone marrow findings and lack of malignant cells make lymphoma less likely.
